about.heading: I'm Mohammed.
about.story1: For the last 5+ years I've designed and built websites for local businesses that didn't know what "good" looked like — until they saw it on a screen about their own business.
about.story2: I work mostly with gyms, clinics, nurseries, restaurants, and construction companies. The kind of businesses where the owner still answers the phone. I love that. I design and code everything myself — no account managers, no project managers, no "team sync."
about.story3: When I'm not designing, I'm probably watching football, making espresso at 1am, or breaking my own portfolio just to rebuild it.

values.title: Craft over speed
values.body: I'd rather ship late and great than fast and forgettable. You're paying for quality, not deadlines I cut corners to hit.

values.title: Conversion = care
values.body: Pretty sites that don't convert are decoration. Every choice I make — copy, layout, color — has a business reason behind it.

values.title: One client at a time

values.title: Communication > deliverables
values.body: Daily Slack/WhatsApp updates. Loom walkthroughs. Async-friendly. You'll never wonder what's happening on your project.

faq.heading: Everything you might be
faq.subtitle: Still have a question? Ask me directly — I reply within 24 hours.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: Most websites ship in 2–3 weeks from kickoff. Landing pages in 1 week. Larger platforms (dashboards, multi-section sites) take 4–6 weeks. I'll give you a precise timeline in the proposal.
Landing pages start at $900. Marketing websites start at $2,500. Custom platforms and dashboards start at $5,000+. I'll always send a fixed quote — no hourly billing surprises.
Yes. 50% to start, 50% on launch. For larger projects, we can split into 3 milestones. I also work with payment plans for nurseries and small restaurants when needed.

items.q: What if I don't have content yet?
items.a: That's normal. I help with copy direction, photography briefs, and stock imagery curation. I can also write your homepage, service pages, and about page as part of the project.

items.q: Do you only build new sites or also redesign?
items.a: Both. About 60% of my work is redesigns — taking an outdated WordPress, Wix, or Webflow site and rebuilding it properly. I'll preserve your SEO and migrate everything safely.

items.q: Will my site be fast on mobile?
items.a: Yes. I optimize for Core Web Vitals obsessively. Every site I ship scores 90+ on Lighthouse for performance, accessibility, and SEO. Mobile is non-negotiable — most of your visitors are on phones.
On-page SEO is included in every project (titles, meta, schema, image optimization, internal linking). For ongoing SEO / content marketing, I work with trusted partners I can refer you to.

30 days of free support for tweaks and bug fixes. After that, I offer a monthly retainer ($200/mo) for updates, new pages, and ongoing optimization. Or you can manage it yourself — I provide training videos.

items.q: Can you work with my existing branding?
items.a: Absolutely. If you have a logo, colors, and brand guide, I'll follow it. If your brand needs refreshing, I can do that too — usually as a small add-on to the project.
Slack or WhatsApp, whichever you prefer. I send daily updates, weekly Loom walkthroughs, and I reply to messages within a few hours during working days. You'll never wonder what's happening.
